title: The headless-runner guards and the KB_HEADLESS_RUNNER marker are removed from the tools
goal: Only the autopilot set KB_HEADLESS_RUNNER, so its guards are dead: remove the marker (bl_intake.HEADLESS_ENV and every reader of it) and the guard code it switches on from kb_hook.py (headless_guard and its PreToolUse wiring in .claude/settings.json), bl_land.py, kg_sync.py (headless target refusal), kbpublic.py, querylog.py (launch does nothing headless), backlog.py, bl_intake.py, kbdecide.py and conftest.py, and the tests that exist only for them (test_headless_guard.py, test_headless_hooks.py, test_headless_start_guarded.py, test_sync_headless.py, test_kbpublic_hook_env.py, test_backlog_headless_operator.py, test_bl_authority_guards.py, test_bl_authority_trust.py, test_docs_headless_statements.py), each removed test id listed in _tools/test_ids_dropped.txt with the reason 'autopilot retired'. Keep the repro rule that an open item's repro runs without a shell (test_open_repros_run_headless) and every interactive behaviour. Nothing may be added to .claude/settings.json. After it, git grep -n KB_HEADLESS_RUNNER finds nothing in _tools, .claude or kb/_self. Interactive session; kb_hook.py, kbpublic.py and the settings are agents-rule files.
